description: Save a search to your account (up to 50). Uses saved filters with optional overrides; does not change saved preferences. Email stays off; turn it on with set_search_email. Saving the same search again returns the existing one.

function.description: Function code from get_filter_options, or several comma-separated to match any of them; empty string clears.

home.description: Display label only; never geocoded. Pass origin coordinates to search.

include_near_misses.description: Include routed jobs up to 1.5 times max_minutes; default false.

include_no_pay.description: Include unknown pay when min_pay is set; default true.

industry.description: Industry code from get_filter_options, or several comma-separated to match any of them; empty string clears.

level.description: Seniority inferred from title and experience: intern, entry, mid, senior, manager or director, or several comma-separated to match any of them; empty string clears.

min_pay.description: Minimum annual USD pay, using posted range midpoint and 2080 hours/year; 0 clears.

origin.description: Driving start coordinates. Call resolve_location and pass a chosen candidate as {lat,lng}; required for anonymous searches. Null clears a saved origin.

query.description: Title/company words or related occupation titles; empty string clears.

saved_only.description: Intersect results with account bookmarks; requires jobs:read; default false.

sort.description: Closest (shortest commute), newest first, or highest annualized pay first; default commute.

name: save_search
title: Save a search
